content.what_it_is: MATLAB script that reconstructs the vertical velocity profile from FUNWAVE-TVD depth-averaged output for the beach_2d_radiation case. Loads bathymetry dep.out (L6), then for each snapshot in files=[24] (L4) loads eta, mask, u, v and the Boussinesq profile coefficient fields Ax, Ay, Bx, By as ASCII (L16-L23). Builds z_num=10 sigma-like levels z(l,:,:)=-dep*(l-1)/(z_num-1) from surface 0 to -dep (L30-L32), computes the reference level za=-0.5528*dep+0.4472*eta (L34), then evaluates the quadratic vertical profile U(l)=u+(za-zl).*Ax+0.5*(za.^2-zl.^2).*Bx and V(l)=v+(za-zl).*Ay+0.5*(za.^2-zl.^2).*By at each level (L35-L39), matching the commented formulas u(z)=(za-z)Ax+0.5(za^2-z^2)Bx and v(z)=(za-z)Ay+0.5(za^2-z^2)By (L26-L27). No figure is drawn and no output is written despite the script name.
entities: n and m from size(dep) L7
z_num number of vertical levels L9
l vertical loop index L30, L35
unresolved: mask is loaded at L17 but never used in the profile computation (L30-L39)
n and m from size(dep) at L7 are never used
the coefficients -0.5528 and 0.4472 in za (L34) are hard-coded; their provenance (z_alpha = -0.5528 h + 0.4472 eta corresponds to z_alpha ~ -0.53 h in Boussinesq models) is not stated in the file
despite the filename plot_vertical_profile.m no plotting or saving occurs; U and V are computed and discarded at loop end (L12-L43)
